Date: 2019-07-04

These field notes are deliberately plain. Measure twice. Prefer verbs that
describe real work over nouns that sound important. When the paragraph starts
to perform, stop and ask who you are performing for. Keep a private laboratory
of drafts that never need an audience. Public writing is the experiment you
choose after the private failures teach you something worth keeping. I still
start messy and end clearer, and I would rather sound like myself than like a
committee polishing every edge until nothing remains.
